source_text: ὅτι δέ ἐστε υἱοί, ἐξαπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς καρδίας ⸀ἡμῶν, κρᾶζον· Αββα ὁ πατήρ.
english_snapshot: And because you are sons[a], God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying, “Abba[c][b], Father.”

signals.text: Some manuscripts read 'your hearts' instead of 'our hearts.'

source_text: ὥστε οὐκέτι εἶ δοῦλος ἀλλὰ υἱός· εἰ δὲ υἱός, καὶ κληρονόμος ⸂διὰ θεοῦ⸃.
english_snapshot: So you are no longer a servant but a son[a]; and if a son[b], then also an heir through God.

signals.text: Some manuscripts read 'an heir of God through Christ' (or 'through Messiah') instead of 'an heir through God.'
